question: Which organisation formerly known as the Imperial Council of Agricultural Research and founded on July 16, 1929, is in charge of Agricultural Research and Education in India?

options.text: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Council of Agricultural Research:-**

 
 
• **ICAR is the organisation formerly known as the Imperial Council of Agricultural Research and founded on July 16, 1929.**
 
• ICAR is responsible for the planning, coordination and promotion of agricultural research and education in India.
 
• It operates through a network of institutes and research centres across the country, working on various aspects of agriculture, including crop improvement, animal sciences, fisheries, natural resource management, and agricultural engineering. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Food Corporation of India:-**

 
 
• FCI is responsible for the procurement and distribution of food grains across the country. 
 
 

 

 
• **Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority:-**

 
 
• APEDA is responsible for the promotion and development of the export of agricultural and processed food products from India.
 
 
 
• **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development:**
 
 
• NABARD is responsible for providing credit and other support services to farmers and rural development activities in India.
